object_entity.proposition_label: Christian communities were established in the Arabian Peninsula
object_entity.description: Christianity was established in the Arabian Peninsula including at Bostra (synod c. 244), and in Himyar through Theophilus the Indian's mission c. 354 (Philostorgius); Najran attested later.

evidence.notes: Philostorgius HE 3.4 describes Theophilus's mission and church building.

passage.excerpt: Paraphrase: Theophilus called the Indian was sent by Emperor Constantius on an embassy to the Himyarites in south Arabia. He was originally from the island of Dibus (Socotra).
